cases.description: Compare Serene/Infused Stone and grass/dirt side seams as 5x5 walls in client, day and night
Check leaves cutout, flower in world/hand/inventory and decaying foliage after breaking log
Check Blue Dream terrain with matching soil, grass top/side, stone and cobble; no tiling seams
Check Dream Necklace existing icon in inventory/creative tab remains legible
Hold Awakener in dream with ALL, DECREASED and MINIMAL particles; MINIMAL must emit none
Place Core Block and confirm subtle nearby ambient particles with acceptable visual density
Use Awakener for 60 ticks in Survival and verify one consumed after actual Overworld return
Release use before 60 ticks, including 20 and 59; confirm no teleport/consumption/cooldown
Return with an invalidated Overworld bed and verify safe fallback or clean non-consuming failure
Check exact initiating offhand item and zero consumption in Creative
Two connected players use their own Awakeners; no cross-consumption or stale activation
Record client FPS, particle settings, restart/reload and assets on a copy of an old save
